explication: MicroPython runs Python scripts on constrained devices and host platforms, exposing a subset of Python plus hardware and system capabilities. The main workflow is a user-provided source or bytecode program entering a platform port, being parsed/compiled and executed by the interpreter, and using available modules to interact with storage, peripherals, or networks. The supplied tree and excerpts omit the core `py/` implementation, so its internal stages and many port-to-subsystem connections are represented only where documented; uncertain wiring is left out.
